Biomedical researcher with specialised expertise in single-cell genomics, epigenetics, and computational analysis of immune and respiratory disease. PhD-trained in genetics with subsequent postdoctoral experience leading computational analyses of interstitial lung disease (ILD) at the [Garvan Institute of Medical Research](https://www.garvan.org.au/), Sydney.

Author of the first single-cell bronchoalveolar lavage atlas in ILD and contributor to multiple high-impact manuscripts in *Nature* and other peer-reviewed journals. Recipient of competitive national research funding and a national society award for excellence in oral presentation.

## Research Interests

- **Interstitial lung disease & IPF** — single-cell transcriptomics and multiomics of alveolar immune cells
- **Epigenomics** — DNA methylation in systemic lupus erythematosus and systemic sclerosis
- **Computational biology** — multi-omic integration, gene regulatory network inference, pipeline development
- **Translational genomics** — bridging molecular findings to clinical outcomes in respiratory disease
